rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or animal that is vicious, cruel, or aggressively dangerous.

example.english: That dog is so vicious that it bites anyone it sees, and even its owner dares not go near it.
example.traditional: 嗰隻狗兇殘到見人就咬，連主人都唔敢行近。
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 gau2 hung1 caan4 dou3 gin3 jan4 zau6 ngaau5 lin4 zyu2 jan4 dou1 m4 gam2 haang4 kan5

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing brutal, destructive cruelty, especially in violence or the conduct of a ruler or group.

example.english: This regime is vicious in its rule and shows no mercy to its opponents.
example.traditional: 呢個政權統治手段殘暴，對反對者毫不留情。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zing3 kyun4 tung2 zi6 sau2 dyun6 caan4 bou6 deoi3 faan2 deoi3 ze2 hou4 bat1 lau4 cing4

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice especially for an aggressive, ill-tempered person or animal, rather than stressing destructive cruelty.

example.english: That security guard is really vicious and loudly tells people off whenever they come near.
example.traditional: 嗰個保安好惡，一見人行近就大聲喝止。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 bou2 on1 hou2 ok3 jat1 gin3 jan4 haang4 kan5 zau6 daai6 seng1 hot3 zi2
